label: Salt dissociation 5ns: does history fraction drift (first-half fraction minus second-half fraction) add on top of the full fraction?
series: K2 (what the guidance is, not where it is)

conditions_definition.base: K15 conditions: train 58 proteins, test 30 proteins (split.json), origin frame 10 (1 ns), history frames 0-10 (100 ps spacing), HistGBM (120 iters, lr 0.075, 31 leaves, min_samples_leaf 15, L2 0.02, seed 42) refit per condition, 5 static features. Salt dissociation, K53 cache.
conditions_definition.fraction: fraction of frames with pair min charged heavy-atom distance <= 4.0 A (same definition as the 'fraction <= 4.0 A' of the 6 statistics) within the given frame range, divided by the number of frames in that range (first/second half: 5, full: 11)

first_half.feature: fraction of frames [0..4] with min distance <= 4.0 A

second_half.feature: fraction of frames [6..10] with min distance <= 4.0 A

conditions_definition.note: Frame 5 (0.5 ns) belongs to neither half by design.
conditions_definition.drift_only: static + drift only (fraction over frames [0..4] minus fraction over frames [6..10])
conditions_definition.both_halves_frac: static + first-half fraction and second-half fraction (2 features)
conditions_definition.base_hist_D6: static + 6 statistics of the full 11-frame history (all-in reference)

base_reproduction.note: Base reproduction is checked against K2-142 (5ns), which matches the K53 salt-dissociation 5ns record to 4 decimal places.

reading_rule_fixed_in_advance.rule: (c) frac_full_plus_drift beats (b) frac_full by AUPRC >= +0.01 -> 'drift adds'; otherwise 'drift does not add'.
reading_rule_fixed_in_advance.verdict: 漂いは足しにならない
